article: How to Pixelate a Selected Area in paint.net
scope: Compared the full Japanese article and twelve translations, each step and effect label, privacy claims, metadata/tags, screenshots and link quality with current official Paint.NET documentation.
findings: Removed the duplicate future date and retained the original 2023-04-11 date; set lastmod to 2026-11-24.
Corrected stale tags copied from a border tutorial and updated descriptions.
Corrected the explanation of Cell Size: larger cells create larger squares but do not guarantee safe concealment.
Updated Scale Down/Scale Up terminology and preserved the documented pixelated appearance settings.
Added a translated warning that pixelation/blur may be reversible; for information that must be hidden, use an opaque mask and export a layerless PNG/JPEG, then inspect the output.
